items.title: Show HN: Building an LLM from Scratch in TypeScript
items.contentSnippet:
I wanted to understand transformers at a level where nothing is magic, so I'm building a ChatGPT-style model from first principles in TypeScript. Why not Python? I've found that reimplementing concepts in a different language forces me to grasp the nuance of the implementation. Chapters cover dataloaders, embeddings, and the attention mechanism so far. Feedback welcome if anything's unclear.

items.title: Show HN: AI investment agreement review for startup founders
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN! 
First, congrats to the founders who received a term sheet(and those who will!)
I made an investment agreement review tool for founders who recently received a term sheet! You can review your term sheets, SAFEs, convertible notes, and financing agreements if your corporation is incorporated in Delaware, from pre-seed through Series A.
It also reviews equity purchase agreements, investor rights, voting terms, and side letters.
Try it and check your potential risks before signing!
